name: fmp-dev-orchestrator
description: The same skill as cadenceux-dx, under its earlier name: routes Claris FileMaker work to the skill or ADK tool that owns it, checks the stack is current, and guides the decisions around the code (native or web viewer, data access, FileMaker 26.0.3 and earlier, reviews, linter tests, security and deployment). Install one of the two, not both.
